تستقربوا (form X)
# تَسْتَقْرِبُوا (tastaqribū) /tas.taq.ri.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْرَبَ (istaqraba)
# تُسْتَقْرَبُوا (tustaqrabū) /tus.taq.ra.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْرَبَ (istaqraba)
